title: 1MCP Server Configuration v1.0.0
description: JSON Schema for 1MCP server configuration files (v1.0.0)

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion and validation

version.description: Version of the configuration format for migration purposes

serverDefaults.description: Shareable defaults inherited by all MCP servers (transport settings only)

env.description: Environment variables as object or array of KEY=VALUE strings

timeout.description: Deprecated: Use connectionTimeout and requestTimeout instead. Fallback timeout in milliseconds

connectionTimeout.description: Timeout for establishing initial connection in milliseconds (takes precedence over timeout)

requestTimeout.description: Timeout for individual request operations in milliseconds (takes precedence over timeout)

clientMetadataUrl.description: HTTPS Client ID Metadata Document URL

credentialAuthority.description: Explicit configured authority shared by compatible template instances

autoRegister.description: Automatically register OAuth client if not already registered

redirectUrl.description: OAuth redirect URL used after auth

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to send with requests

inheritParentEnv.description: Whether to inherit environment variables from parent process

envFilter.description: List of environment variable names to include when inheritParentEnv is true

restartOnExit.description: Enable runtime-owned automatic restart after an unexpected stdio backend exit

maxRestarts.description: Maximum consecutive restart attempts (omitted = 5, 0 = unlimited; resets after 5 stable minutes)

restartDelay.description: Initial restart delay in milliseconds (omitted = 1000; backoff is 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, then 16x)

preparation.description: Runtime-owned definition or inline commands and explicit action permissions

projectTarget.description: Runtime-owned project targeting; templates default to single and static backends to independent

type.description: Transport type for connecting to the MCP server

protocolVersion.description: Outbound MCP protocol negotiation mode (defaults to auto when omitted)

disabled.description: Disable this server. Can be a boolean value or a template string that evaluates to a boolean (e.g., "{?project.environment=production}")

disabledTools.description: Hide specific tools from this server without disabling the entire server

instructionOverride.description: Literal replacement for upstream instructions; an empty string intentionally suppresses them

toolDescriptionOverrides.description: Override upstream tool descriptions by logical tool name; blank descriptions are not supported
